sections.title: Where YQUP helps

sections.title: Useful first conversation

sections.title: Longer runs need better judgement
sections.body: As agents move from demos into ongoing work, judgement becomes the core control surface: what to continue, stop, escalate, or reframe.

sections.title: Built for practical systems

name: My Agentic

sections.title: Long-lived, bounded, reviewable

sections.title: Research into delivery
sections.body: Notes, experiments, and implementation patterns turn agentic ideas into systems people can operate.

name: Chief Agentic Officer
title: Chief Agentic Officer | Leadership for agentic work
heading: Chief Agentic Officer.
summary: A board-level role for turning agentic AI from scattered pilots into accountable operating capability.
brief_title: Agentic work needs ownership after the pilot.
brief: The Chief Agentic Officer connects board intent, operating reality, governance, and AI-enabled delivery. The role exists because agentic systems need visible ownership once the excitement of the demo has passed.
brief_support: This is not a job title for buying tools. It is an operating model for deciding where agents should be trusted, where they must be bounded, and how human judgement stays in the loop without slowing useful work to a crawl.

sections.title: Intent
sections.heading: Turn board ambition into a usable mandate.
sections.body: Clarify the problems agentic systems are meant to solve, the appetite for risk, and the decisions that should remain human.

sections.title: Control
sections.heading: Make boundaries inspectable before scale.
sections.body: Define permissions, stop conditions, escalation paths, evidence trails, and review points so agents can work without becoming unowned automation.

sections.title: Rhythm
sections.heading: Build a cadence the organisation can live with.
sections.body: Move from isolated pilots to a steady operating rhythm: weekly review, visible ownership, useful metrics, and decisions that travel cleanly from boardroom to delivery.

operating_notes.title: Map the current AI estate

operating_notes.title: Set trust boundaries
operating_notes.body: Decide what agents may read, suggest, change, spend, publish, escalate, or stop.

operating_notes.title: Create reviewable memory
operating_notes.body: Keep enough record of context, decisions, and exceptions for leaders to inspect the work after the fact.

name: Orchistra
title: Orchistra | Shepherds of agentic systems
heading: Orchistra
summary: A living field map for agentic work: see what is moving, set useful boundaries, read the weak signals, and bring outcomes back into judgement.
brief_title: A clearer way to see agentic work in motion.
brief: Orchistra gives leaders a practical map of the agents, automations, vendors, prompts, permissions, and workarounds already moving through the business.
brief_support: It is less command centre, more attentive field craft: count what exists, set the hedges, watch for drift, and make sure useful work returns as records, decisions, and learning.
work_title: From loose agents to a visible operating field.
tone_title: Quiet enough to notice drift. Sharp enough to intervene.
tone_body: Agentic systems do not need theatre. They need a rhythm that makes motion legible: what changed, what crossed a boundary, what looks odd, and what needs human judgement before small drift becomes operational damage.
cadence_body: Before an organisation scales agentic work, leaders need a recurring rhythm for what exists, what changed, what crossed a boundary, and what needs judgement.
cta_title: Start with the work already moving.
cta_body: Which agents, automations, vendor workflows, and quiet experiments are already shaping decisions, and who is actually shepherding them?
footer_tagline: Field maps, operating cadence, and practical governance for agentic systems.

sections.title: Count
sections.heading: Know what is already moving.
sections.body: Map agents, automations, vendor tools, prompts, permissions, and side experiments before they become invisible infrastructure.

sections.title: Bound
sections.heading: Give autonomy a visible edge.
sections.body: Set what each system can read, suggest, change, publish, spend, escalate, stop, and remember.

sections.title: Return
sections.heading: Bring the work back into judgement.
sections.body: Turn agent activity into records, decisions, exceptions, lessons, and next actions that leaders can inspect.

operating_notes.title: Bring it home
operating_notes.body: Turn agentic activity into decisions, records, lessons, and a rhythm that leaders can inspect.
